semantics: SIGTERM/SIGINT/(Windows) SIGBREAK set stop flag; flag checked only at cycle boundary -> in-flight cycle completes (drain), training subprocess never truncated
idle wait uses <=1s sliced sleep so stop requests take effect promptly
kill-switch drain: after each cycle policy re-read; enabled=false -> watch-stop reason=disabled-kill-switch (fail-closed, no idle retry)
signal handlers restored on exit; injected stop_event => no signal takeover (embed/test paths)

checks: drain-on-stop: stop raised mid-cycle -> cycle completes, exits rc=0 with watch-stop/stop-signal
kill-switch-drain: enabled_fn false after cycle -> watch-stop/disabled-kill-switch, rc=0
sliced-sleep-wake: 60s interval exits ~1.2s after stop (<=1s slice granularity)
